t: One player for everything you watch
x: Kastideo is free. If the app serves you well, you can support its development. It is entirely optional. Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi Other ways to help ↑ Back to top
Pick a channel and it starts, usually in under a second. Kastideo then keeps you in control: stream health, timeshift, a version matched to your connection.

Playback starts as soon as you select a channel. While it opens, the channel logo and name are shown, then a “Ready in x s” badge tells you the start time. Controls appear on hover: pause, volume, cinema mode. A double-click switches to cinema mode: the window goes full screen and only the video stays. Esc leaves it.

h: Knowing if the stream is good
x: A health pill shows reception quality: green (Excellent), orange (Fair) or red (Unstable), with the picture definition (SD, HD, Full HD or 4K). On hover you see the bitrate, frames per second, dropped frames and interruptions from the last minute. On Mac, an Information panel shows the current and upcoming programme, the audio track (language, audio description) and subtitles.

Pause a channel: Kastideo keeps receiving the stream and stores it. When you resume, you watch time-shifted, shown by a yellow indicator (for example “DELAYED −2:34”). A timeline runs from the moment you paused (left) to live (right). Drag the cursor right: playback speeds up to the chosen point, then returns to normal speed. Speeds ×1.25, ×1.5 and ×2 let you eat into the delay. The Catch up button speeds up to live without skipping anything. Back to live returns to the broadcast immediately. The maximum timeshift length is set in the playback settings. Good to know Timeshift is stored in a temporary folder of the app, cleared when you change channel. Most IPTV subscriptions allow only one simultaneous stream. Kastideo always closes the current stream before opening the next: you can zap without risk of exceeding your limit. Before interrupting a recording, it asks for your approval. If a channel does not start, check that no other device (TV, phone) is using the same subscription, and turn off any VPN.

Many providers offer a channel in several versions (4K, FHD, HD, SD). In the themes view, Kastideo shows only one and picks the best fit for your connection: it steps down after an unstable playback and steps up after three smooth ones. A right-click on the channel lets you choose another version.

Favourites and recents : a star or a right-click adds a favourite. Recents keep the last 60 items watched, with multiple deletion and an Undo button. Search : one field searches channels, movies and series. Categories : reorder, hide or rename your provider's categories, or hide by keyword. No more country categories you never watch. Fix a channel : a right-click lets you change its name, number, logo and the TV guide channel it matches.
A grid guide to see the whole evening at a glance, and a theme view to find sport, films or news right now.

Channels are in rows, hours in columns, with a red line on the current time. Arrows shift the grid, Now returns to the present time, and the date menu jumps to another day. The displayed span can be 2, 3 or 6 hours. Filter by favourites, recents, category or theme, or search for a channel. A click on a programme opens its sheet: description, Watch button, Record (current programme) or Schedule recording (upcoming programme). A red dot marks a scheduled recording, and a bell lets you get an alert at the start.

h: A backup guide when your provider's is incomplete
x: If your provider's guide is empty or patchy, Kastideo can load a second one (xmltvfr.fr) and automatically matches its channels to yours by name. You can also fix the match by hand, channel by channel.

Live TV is sorted by theme: Sport, Motor, Films, Series, News, Documentaries, Nature, Kids, Entertainment, Cooking and Home, Music, General, Regional, International, Religion and Radio. Three modes: Now : what is on right now, sorted by the programme's genre in the guide. A film on a general channel therefore appears under “Films”, with its progress. Tonight : programmes starting between 8 pm and 11 pm. Channels : channels sorted by specialty. The theme is deduced from the channel name, then from its usual programmes, and can be corrected with a right-click. Under Sport, a second row filters by discipline: football, rugby, tennis, basketball, combat sports, golf, cycling, handball, motor spo

Kastideo warns you two minutes before a show starts: a specific programme, a title containing a word you chose (“Formula 1”, a team name), or a theme on your favourite channels. A notification and a Watch banner appear, even if the window was minimised.
Kastideo looks the way you prefer, and can even change its face depending on what you watch: one interface for live TV, another for movies.

The choice is made separately for live TV, movies, series, and favourites and recents. Classic : three columns, with the sidebar, the list (and each channel's current programme) and the player or details on the right. This is the default interface. Cinema : a large scrolling “featured” banner, then horizontal rows: resume playback, favourites and one row per category. Movies and series appear as posters, channels as thumbnails with the current programme. A click on a movie opens its details page. TV (live only): the channel full frame, like on a television. Up and down arrows to zap, digits to type a number, left arrow for the channel list, B to go back to the previous channel, G for the gui

In Cinema, a full-width carousel highlights movies and series: a category of your choice, weekly trends (via TMDB) found in your catalogue and your provider's latest additions. For live TV, it shows the current programmes of your favourite and recent channels. You set its height, pause on hover and the trailer button, or hide it. A country and language filter lets you show only what interests you.

Dark, light, or system theme. Accent colour of your choice: blue, purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. List density (compact, standard, airy) and thumbnail size. The player, home screen, details pages and TV interface stay dark, for comfort in front of the screen.
For Live, Movies and Series, choose what is shown at launch: the whole catalogue, your favourites, your recents, the last item watched or a specific category.

A dedicated window lets you reorder, hide and rename the categories of each section, sort them A to Z and hide by keyword. On Windows, Linux and Android, you can also arrange the order of the channels themselves by drag and drop, move them to another category or a personal list, and restore the original order.

One configuration file gathers your sources, favourites, recents, categories, interfaces and TMDB key, with passwords if you decide so. The format is the same on Mac, Windows, Linux and Android: you move from one computer to another in one click, or restore everything after changing machines.
Follow several matches, several news channels or an election night on a single screen: up to four live channels, with sound following the tile you pick.

MultiView shows one to four channels: one full frame, two side by side, three or four in a grid. Sound follows the active tile, outlined in orange. Click a tile, or press keys 1 to 4, to activate it. The + button adds a channel from your favourites, recents or search. On hover, you can change a tile's channel or remove it. The channel name and current programme are shown at the bottom. Stop all cuts every stream. You choose the number of screens (1 to 4) and the layout: side by side, stacked, grid, or one big picture with the others as small floating tiles. In the latter, you move the tiles, which snap to the nearest corner, and swap them with the big one by double-clicking. On Windows, Linu

If you have several live sources, MultiView mixes them: two subscriptions, or a subscription and a list of public channels. Each source has its own number of connections, for example 1 for a limited subscription and 4 for a public list. Each screen is reserved for one source, and its channel picker only offers that source's channels. The picker follows the Classic interface: favourites, recents and categories on the left, channels with their current programme on the right.

During live TV, the picture-in-picture button opens a second channel as a thumbnail in a corner of the player, without sound. A click on the thumbnail swaps it with the main channel. The second channel must come from a source with a free connection: with a single subscription limited to one connection, pick a channel from a public list or from a second subscription.

h: Why it is off by default
x: Each channel uses one connection to your provider. Since most subscriptions allow only one, MultiView stays disabled until you enter the number of simultaneous connections of your subscription, from 2 to 4, in the playback settings. For an Xtream source, the Test connection button shows this number. Good to know A recording or a download also uses one connection. If a tile shows “The channel is not responding”, the provider probably refuses one more connection: remove a channel.

From the Playback menu, with a right-click on a channel (Add to MultiView), or with a keyboard shortcut. The channel you were watching becomes the first tile, and main playback stops to free its connection, unless it is being recorded.
Keep a show for later, or download a movie overnight to watch it offline. Everything is found in the Recordings section.

A red button in the player bar starts recording the channel you are watching. It stops at the end of the current programme (from the TV guide, plus a margin) or when you stop it. Recording uses the same connection as playback: it consumes nothing more on your subscription. On Mac, recording starts immediately, then a banner offers the automatic stop: in 15 minutes to 4 hours, at an exact time or with no limit. With no choice, it stops at the end of the programme, or after the default duration set in Settings > Recordings. The Duration button of the current recording changes the stop at any time and shows the time left. A right-click on another channel lets you record it in the background: if

From the TV guide or with a right-click on a channel, schedule a guide programme or a free time slot. Margins before and after (2 and 5 minutes by default on Mac) avoid missing the start or the end. On Windows, Linux and Android, you can repeat: once, every day, Monday to Friday or every week. Good to know Kastideo must be open, and the device on, at the scheduled time. On Mac, it prevents automatic sleep during activity. On Windows and Linux, a setting launches it at sign-in.

h: Downloading a movie or a series
x: A right-click on a movie or an episode offers Download, or Download tonight (at 2 am by default, adjustable). For a series, the details page lets you download the displayed season or the whole series. Downloads run one after another, with pause, resume after an interruption and cancel. A permanent indicator shows progress, the current episode, speed and estimated time left.

Since your subscription usually allows only one connection, Kastideo does one thing at a time and always asks before interrupting something. Changing channel during a recording asks whether the recording should stop. Starting playback during a download pauses it: it resumes by itself afterwards.

Recordings are stored in a folder of your choice (by default Movies/Kastideo on Mac, Videos/Kastideo on Windows and Linux), with automatic names like “TF1 – Le goût du détail – 2026-10-18 20h50”. An optional automatic clean-up sends old recordings to the trash, and an alert warns you when disk space runs low. On Mac, you can also tidy the list: remove one recording, several (Select mode) or the whole list. By default only the list is cleaned and the file stays in the folder; a checkbox deletes it too, and an Undo banner puts everything back for a few seconds. Recordings are for private use only, within the limits of the law in your country.
Send what you are watching to a TV on the same network, without leaving Kastideo. The playback bar stays your remote control.

Chromecast, Google TV, Android TV , and many TVs with built-in Chromecast: the whole playback moves to the TV. Live channel, movie, series or local video. Apple TV (AirPlay) : Kastideo cannot send video directly over AirPlay. On Mac, use macOS screen mirroring, then play Kastideo full screen. A shortcut to display settings is offered in the TV button menu. YouTube : the video opens in the TV's YouTube app, or in the browser with Chrome's Cast button, as chosen in the settings.

Start a channel, movie, series or video. Click the TV button in the playback bar. Pick the device in the list (Search again if nothing shows: the TV must be on and on the same network). The picture goes to the TV, and playback resumes where you were. Pause, play, skip forward and back, position, volume and mute in the bar act on the TV. To come back, choose Stop casting: playback resumes on the computer at the same position.

One connection to your provider: while casting, the computer no longer plays the channel. Live TV cannot be moved back and forth in time while casting, and the computer's timeshift is cut. Recording a channel and MultiView cannot be combined with casting. There is a delay of a few seconds, more than with local playback.

Mac : macOS asks on first use for permission to find devices on the local network. Accept, otherwise no TV appears. Windows and Linux : Kastideo prepares the video with ffmpeg before sending (included with the Windows version and the AppImage, to install with the .deb package). The Windows firewall may ask to allow Kastideo: accept on private networks. Android : casting uses direct mode, the stream address being sent as-is to the TV. Local files cannot be cast.

Many IPTV providers keep the programmes of past days. Kastideo puts this archive right into the TV guide: you find the show you missed and play it. One condition Replay depends on your subscription: your provider must offer an archive for the channel, and its length varies from one provider to another. When it does, a small ↺ appears next to the channel.

The date menu offers the previous days, in a Watch again section. Click a past programme of a channel marked ↺, then Watch again. On the current programme, Watch from the start replays the show from its beginning, even if you missed the first part.
A right-click on a channel offers Replay with the recent programmes of that channel. In Cinema, a “Watch again” row gathers those of your favourite channels that have an archive.

The player bar allows pause and seeking within the programme. At the end, Kastideo returns to the channel's live broadcast. A setting lets you turn this off. Record this replay downloads the programme from the archive into your recordings folder, to keep it.

Turn replay on or off. The number of days of past programmes kept in the guide: more days need more memory. Time offset: if the programme you watch is shifted by a few minutes or an hour, you fix it once and for all. The server's time zone is read automatically.

Replay counts as one connection: it closes the current channel, like a channel change. If it does not start, the playback log shows the archive address built and the offset used. The provider's guide must contain past programmes: reload it after increasing the number of days kept.
A catalogue you browse like a video library: posters, full details pages, and resume exactly where you left off.

A click on the poster of a movie or series opens its page: large background image, poster, year, runtime, genres, rating, plot, director and cast with photos. The Play or Resume, Trailer, Download and favourite buttons are close at hand, with a Back button to return to the catalogue. Information comes first from your provider. With a free TMDB key, entered in the settings, pages are more complete and titles, plots and episodes are in the interface language.
A series opens on its page with its seasons and episodes. Episode titles and plots are localised when TMDB provides them. You can download a season or the whole series to watch offline.

Kastideo remembers your position. When you reopen an item, playback resumes where you stopped, with a message offering to start over. Progress bars appear in lists, on posters and in episodes. You can turn off memorisation or erase positions. With Jellyfin, Emby and Plex, position and “watched” status are shared both ways: a movie started in Kastideo resumes on the TV, and the other way round.

A country and language filter in Cinema hides what does not interest you. The “featured” banner highlights a category of your choice, weekly trends and the latest additions. A single search covers live TV, movies and series.

For the movies on your drives or NAS, Kastideo adds a poster and plot when the file name is recognised. If a poster is wrong, Fix the details lets you search for the right title: the choice is remembered. Subtitles placed next to the file are loaded at playback.
Kastideo provides no content: you bring your sources, it plays them all in the same interface. Credentials stay on your device.

The most common format among IPTV providers. You need the server address (for example http://example.com:8080), your username and your password. The Test connection button checks your credentials and shows the account status, its expiry date and the number of simultaneous connections allowed. The password is kept in the system's secure store, never in clear text on disk. The server's TV guide is used automatically. Series open on a page with their seasons and episodes.

By address or by .m3u or .m3u8 file. If the address looks like get.php?username=…&password=…, Kastideo recognises it and saves it as an Xtream source: loading is much faster and the TV guide is included. Categories come from the playlist, and entries are automatically sorted into live, movies or series.

Add folders from a drive, a USB stick or a NAS: Kastideo recognises movies and series from file names (“Inception (2010).mkv”, “Breaking.Bad.S01E02.mkv”, a “Kaamelott/Season 3/…” folder). Movies appear in Movies, episodes are grouped into series with their seasons, and other videos (holidays, camera) go in a Videos section. Folders are scanned at every launch and then every 20 minutes: a video you add appears by itself. If the drive is unplugged, a message says so and the previous list is kept. Subtitles placed next to a video (“Movie.srt”, “Movie.en.srt”) are loaded at playback.

A Search the network button finds the servers at home. For Plex, Sign in with Plex opens plex.tv: you authorise Kastideo and pick your server. Libraries appear in Movies and Series, with the server's posters, details, seasons and episodes. Playback is direct, without conversion, and resume and “watched” status are shared both ways.

The YouTube section plays videos with YouTube's official player, in enhanced privacy mode. It is not an ad blocker. Follow channels by pasting their link or @handle: their latest videos appear without a key or account. Search needs a free Google API key, which you create in a few minutes. Paste a video or playlist link to play it. Favourites, history and “Watch later” resume where you left off. You can import your subscriptions from a Google Takeout export.
The backup file gathers your sources and can also be imported on another device: see Interfaces and personalisation .
A player is judged by what happens when things go wrong. Here is what Kastideo does to start fast, last all evening and stay discreet.

Channel start usually in under a second, with a “Ready in x s” badge that measures it. Adjustable buffer on Mac: Fast (default), Balanced or Stable, depending on whether you prefer immediacy or tolerance to interruptions. An Xtream account loads quickly : catalogues of tens of thousands of items open without waiting, and get.php addresses are automatically converted to an Xtream source, which is faster. Smooth navigation : moving from live to movies or series does not reload the catalogue.

Stream health at all times: a green, orange or red pill, with details on hover. Start watchdog : if a channel does not start, Kastideo tries the other stream format (.ts or .m3u8), then shows an explicit error with the server's last answer, instead of spinning forever. Frozen picture : when the picture stays stuck for more than 6 seconds while the stream keeps arriving, Kastideo reopens the channel with software decoding and remembers it. You can also enable it per channel or for everything. Channel with no sound : Kastideo tries the other audio tracks and flags the problem with an icon. One connection at a time : the previous stream is closed cleanly before each new one, so you do not excee

The playback log keeps the detail of every opening: address tried, server answer, attempts, Kastideo's decisions. Credentials are masked in it. It is sorted by topic, filterable, searchable and copyable in one click, which lets you report a problem precisely. First reflex An active VPN often disturbs IPTV providers. Turn it off before digging further.

No account to create with Kastideo. The app works with your sources, and that is all. Your credentials stay on your device , in the system's secure store, and are sent only to the services you configure. No usage statistics are collected by the app. Discreet updates : the check happens at launch, never during viewing or recording, and installing is optional. For the details of data, see the privacy policy .
The reference version, where new features arrive first. Current version: … . Download for Mac Short address: kastideo.com/dl/mac . In a terminal: curl -LJO https://kastideo.com/dl/mac
macOS 14 Sonoma or later. An Apple processor (M1 to M4) or Intel.

Download the Kastideo-X.Y.Z.dmg file with the button above. Open it and drag Kastideo into the Applications folder. Launch the app. It is signed with an Apple developer certificate and checked by Apple: macOS asks for no workaround. At first launch, add your source (Xtream Codes, M3U, folder or server) in the settings: see Your sources .

Kastideo checks for updates with Sparkle, at launch. A banner appears only when you are not watching anything, never during viewing or recording. Installing is optional and updates are signed. An option also lets you receive beta versions.

Recordings converted to MP4, playable by QuickTime, iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync with your iPhone and iPad: sources, favourites, resume positions, categories and corrected pages, through an iCloud Drive folder. Information panel with audio track and subtitle selection. Adjustable buffer: Fast, Balanced or Stable. Casting to Apple TV through macOS screen mirroring: see Casting to a TV .

A preview version: it works well, but your feedback remains valuable. Current version: … . Setup.exe installer Portable version (.zip) Short addresses: kastideo.com/dl/windows (installer) and kastideo.com/dl/windows-zip (portable). In PowerShell: Invoke-WebRequest https://kastideo.com/dl/windows -OutFile Kastideo-setup.exe
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.

Download Kastideo-…-windows-x64-setup.exe and run it. Installation is per user, with no administrator rights. Or, with no installation: download Kastideo-…-windows-x64.zip , extract it wherever you like and run Kastideo.exe. Windows warning The app is not signed yet: Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”. Click More info, then Run anyway. The message does not come back afterwards.

Kastideo checks for new versions at launch and then every 12 hours. When one is available, Install and restart downloads and installs the update according to your installation type (installer or portable version).

MKV recordings, with repeat (every day, Monday to Friday, every week). MultiView with layout choice and saved channel groups. ffmpeg is included, for casting to a TV: see Casting to a TV . Option to launch at sign-in, handy for scheduled recordings.
A preview version, in two formats depending on your system. Current version: … .

Two terminal commands give the answer: lsb_release -d for the distribution and uname -m for the architecture. .deb, Zorin OS 17 · Ubuntu 22.04 ubuntu22.04_amd64 Short address: kastideo.com/dl/deb22 .deb, Zorin OS 18 · Ubuntu 24.04 ubuntu24.04_amd64 Short address: kastideo.com/dl/deb AppImage, 64-bit PC linux-x86_64 ( uname -m : x86_64) Short address: kastideo.com/dl/linux AppImage, Raspberry Pi 4 or 5 linux-aarch64 ( uname -m : aarch64, 64-bit system) Short address: kastideo.com/dl/linux-arm In a terminal, for example: curl -LJO https://kastideo.com/dl/linux (64-bit PC AppImage).

Double-click the file, or open a terminal in the Downloads folder: sudo apt install ./kastideo_X.Y.Z_ubuntu22.04_amd64.deb Replace the name with that of the downloaded file. To cast to a TV, also install ffmpeg: sudo apt install ffmpeg

Right-click the file, Properties, Permissions, and tick Allow executing as a program. Or in a terminal: chmod +x Kastideo-…AppImage . Double-click it. ffmpeg is already included. If it does not start, install the FUSE library: sudo apt install libfuse2 ( libfuse2t64 on Ubuntu 24.04 and Zorin OS 18).
Kastideo checks for new versions at launch and then every 12 hours. Install and restart adapts to your installation type: for a .deb, the new package is downloaded then installed after your approval.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: Kastideo is not on Google Play: installation uses the APK file, without changing the device's security. Download the APK, then open it. If Android blocks installing unknown apps, tap Settings and enable Allow from this source for the app you are using (Chrome, for example). Others stay blocked. Confirm the installation. If Play Protect shows a warning, choose Install anyway. On an Android TV : install the free Downloader app and type the APK address, or copy the APK onto a USB stick and open it with a file manager, or send it from a phone with “Send Files to TV”.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: The ☰ menu opens the sections. A long press on a channel, movie or episode opens the menu (favourite, record, replay…). In the player, a tap shows the bar; a double-tap on the left skips back 10 s, on the right forward 30 s, in the centre pauses; a vertical swipe sets volume (right) or brightness (left). In landscape, the channel goes full screen.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: On Android TV, arrows move the selection, OK confirms and Back goes back. For live TV, the TV interface opens by default: up and down (or Channel +/−) change channel, digits enter a number, left opens the channel list. For movies and series, the Cinema interface opens: OK pauses, left and right skip back 10 s or forward 30 s. The remote's Play/Pause and fast-forward/rewind keys are supported.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: Casting to a TV uses direct mode and does not handle local files: see Casting to a TV . Recordings and downloads are stored in the app's folder. Android may interrupt a background app: keep Kastideo open and the device plugged in during a recording. No launch at sign-in. YouTube opens in the device's browser.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: Kastideo tells you when a new version exists. Download the new APK and install it over the old one: your settings are kept.

t: Kastideo for Android and Android TV
x: “App not installed”: try the universal APK, or check there is enough free space. The file does not open: use a file manager rather than the browser. A channel does not start: turn off the VPN and check the playback log (see Fast, stable and frugal ).

A native app for iOS 17 or later. It is being tested through TestFlight, Apple's service for trying an app before its release. We hope to see it on the App Store soon, with no date announced for now. Not on the App Store yet For now, the only way to try Kastideo on iPhone and iPad is TestFlight. There is no file to install by hand.

Write to contact@kastideo.com with the email address of your Apple ID and your device (iPhone or iPad). You receive a TestFlight invitation. Install the free TestFlight app from the App Store. Open the invitation, then install Kastideo from TestFlight. Updates also arrive through TestFlight. Your feedback is valuable: the playback log can be shared from Settings > About.

Read and accept the notice, then tap Add a source (Xtream Codes or M3U list). You can also import your configuration from a Mac, a PC or an Android device: sources, favourites and categories. Kastideo provides no channels: content comes from your sources, whose legality you must check. See Play an M3U playlist .

A home screen in the spirit of the desktop version: large Live, Movies, Series, YouTube and My videos tiles, then Continue, Recents, Favourites, TV guide and Recordings. Live TV as a list, in Cinema display or by themes, with replay when your provider offers it. Grid TV guide like on Mac: one row per channel, hours and channels always visible, pinch to zoom the time scale, filters by favourites, recents, theme or category. Movies and series in Cinema display or as a grid, with details pages, seasons and episodes, and automatic playback of the next episode. Full-screen player with gestures (double-tap to skip forward, back or pause, drag for volume, brightness or to change channel), playback

Optional and off by default, iCloud sync brings your sources, favourites, history, categories, display settings, resume positions and corrected pages to your iPhone, iPad and Mac. It goes through a folder of your iCloud Drive, which you choose to be the same on every device. Passwords are synchronised only if you decide so, and encrypted with a passphrase of your choice.

No picture in picture for now. No scheduled recording: the app cannot wake itself on iPhone. Use programme alerts, or the Mac. AirPlay sends sound to an Apple TV or a HomePod. For video, use iOS screen mirroring. See also Kastideo for Apple TV .

Answers to the questions we are asked most often about Kastideo.

h: Does Kastideo provide channels or an IPTV subscription?
x: No. Kastideo is a player: it does not provide, host or sell any channel, movie or subscription. You bring your own sources and you are responsible for their legality. See Your sources .
Yes. No feature is paid, no account is asked and no ads are shown. Support is possible and entirely optional: Support the project .

h: Which devices does it run on?
x: On Mac (stable version), and as a preview on Windows 10 and 11, Linux (Zorin OS, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi) and Android, including Android TV. Versions for iPhone and iPad and for Apple TV are being tested through TestFlight, not on the App Store yet. See Download .
An Xtream Codes subscription, an M3U playlist, folders on your drives or NAS, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex servers, and YouTube.

h: Why only one channel at a time?
x: Most IPTV subscriptions allow only one simultaneous connection. Kastideo closes the current stream before opening another to avoid exceeding your limit. With a multi-connection subscription, MultiView shows up to four channels.
It relies on your provider's archive: when one exists, past programmes appear in the TV guide and play in one click. See Programme replay .

h: Why can't I see replay when my provider offers it?
x: Replay only appears if Kastideo detects an archive for the channel: the ↺ icon then shows next to it. Check in this order: Replay is enabled : Settings > General > Replay. The archive exists for this channel : some subscriptions keep channels for up to 14 days, but not all of them. The guide contains past programmes : increase the number of days kept in the guide (Settings > General > Replay), then reload the guide. More days need more memory. The time offset : adjust it if the programme that starts is not the one you chose. The 6-hour delay : at launch, Kastideo only reloads a source if its last update is more than 6 hours old (adjustable). A recent guide or archive may therefore be missing

x: Outside Google Play, with the Downloader app, a USB stick or by sending it from a phone. See Install Kastideo on Android TV , or on Fire TV .
Your credentials stay on your device, in the system's secure store, and are sent only to the services you configure. Kastideo collects no usage statistics. See the privacy policy .

h: A channel does not start, what should I do?
x: First turn off any VPN, check that no other device uses your subscription, then look at the playback log. See Fast, stable and frugal .
By e-mail at contact@kastideo.com , or on GitHub for a problem or an idea.

You have an M3U or M3U8 playlist (an address or a file) and want to watch it with a TV guide and sorted channels. Here is how to do it with Kastideo on Mac, Windows, Linux and Android, in five minutes.

Your playlist: either its address (starting with http) or an .m3u or .m3u8 file. Kastideo installed on your device (step 1). Kastideo provides no channels: the playlist comes from you, and you must check that its content is legal. To try without a subscription Community lists of public streams exist, for example the iptv-org/iptv repository on GitHub, which contains only links and no video. Kastideo is not affiliated with that project in any way, provides or guarantees none of these streams, and does not verify their availability or their legality. You remain responsible for checking that using them is legal in your country, and for respecting rights holders.

Mac (macOS 14 Sonoma or later): download the .dmg file from Kastideo for Mac , open it and drag the app into the Applications folder. Windows 10 and 11 : download the installer from Kastideo for Windows , no administrator rights needed. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info then Run anyway : the app is not signed yet. Linux : .deb package or AppImage from Kastideo for Linux . Android and Android TV : APK file from Kastideo for Android , or the guide Install Kastideo on Android TV .

At first launch, click Add a source . Later: open Settings (⌘, on Mac, Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux, or the cog on the home screen) then Sources then Add a source . Choose M3U playlist . By address: paste the playlist address. By file: click Choose a file… and pick the .m3u or .m3u8 file. On Mac, Kastideo keeps the permission to access it so it can refresh it. Click Add : Kastideo loads the channels and the TV guide.

Categories come from the playlist's group-title attribute, logos from tvg-logo and the TV guide match from tvg-id . Kastideo sorts entries into Live, Movies or Series from their address. If the address looks like get.php?username=…&password=… , Kastideo recognises it and saves it as an Xtream Codes source: loading is faster, the TV guide is included and, on Mac, the password is kept in the keychain. See Add an Xtream Codes subscription .
A plain M3U playlist does not always contain a guide. Kastideo can load a backup guide (xmltvfr.fr) and match it to your channels by name: see TV guide and themes .

In Settings > General > Startup and files , tick Open .m3u and .m3u8 files with Kastideo : a double-click on a playlist offers to add it as a source. If Windows still opens another program, right-click the file, Open with , Choose another app , then Kastideo.
Kastideo must be open at the scheduled time. On Windows and Linux, turn on Launch Kastideo at sign-in and Start minimised so it stays out of the way. See Recording and downloading .
Open Live, browse the themes , try MultiView or record a show . If a channel does not start: Fast, stable and frugal .
Xtream Codes is the most common format among IPTV providers. With three pieces of information, Kastideo loads your channels, movies, series and the server's TV guide.
Your provider gave them to you: the server address, for example http://example.com:8080 ; your username ; your password .

At first launch, click Add a source . Otherwise: Settings (⌘, on Mac, Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux), Sources , Add . Choose Xtream Codes and enter the server, username and password. Click Test connection (Mac): Kastideo checks your credentials and shows the account status, its expiry date and the number of simultaneous connections allowed. Click Add .
It is kept in your system's secure store: macOS keychain, Windows Credential Manager, GNOME keyring or KWallet on Linux. It is never written in clear text on disk and is sent only to your provider.

The server's TV guide is used automatically. Series open on a page with their seasons and episodes. Replay appears on channels whose provider keeps an archive. The number of simultaneous connections allowed is used to enable MultiView .

h: Do you have a get.php address?
x: If your provider gave you a playlist address of the form get.php?username=…&password=… , simply paste it as an M3U playlist: Kastideo recognises it and saves it as Xtream Codes, with the benefits above. See Play an M3U playlist .

Check the address, port, username and password, letter by letter. Turn off any VPN, which often disturbs providers. Check the subscription has not expired, and that no other device uses it if the limit is one connection. Look at the playback log: Fast, stable and frugal . Kastideo provides no subscription. Check that your provider is legal.

Fire TV Stick, Fire TV Cube and Fire TV televisions run Fire OS, a system derived from Android. Kastideo is not on the Amazon Appstore: you install it from its APK file, with the free Downloader app. Compatibility Kastideo's Android APK declares a TV entry, so it should appear in “Your Apps & Channels”. Fire TV devices are not yet among the officially tested ones: this procedure relies on compatibility with Android, and your feedback is welcome at contact@kastideo.com . A very old model may refuse the installation.

Take universal : it is the largest, but it works everywhere. Several Fire TV devices, even recent ones, run a 32-bit system: the arm64-v8a file may then be refused. If you prefer a lighter file, try armeabi-v7a . In Downloader, type kastideo.com/tvu (universal), kastideo.com/tv32 (armeabi-v7a) or kastideo.com/tv (arm64-v8a): these addresses always point to the latest version. The files are also on the Kastideo for Android and Android TV page.
On the Fire TV home screen, open search and type Downloader . Choose the Downloader app (orange icon) then Get or Download .

Open Settings then My Fire TV then Developer options . If this menu does not appear: My Fire TV then About , select the device name seven times in a row, then go back. Open Install unknown apps and turn on Downloader . This permission only concerns Downloader. You do not need to disable any other protection.

Open Downloader. In the address field, type github.com/jihemezes/kastideo/releases and confirm. Find the version whose name ends with -android , expand its files and choose the universal APK. When the download is finished, select Install , then Open . Downloader then offers to delete the file: accept, it saves space.

Kastideo is in Your Apps & Channels . To bring it closer to the home screen: select it, press the Menu button (three lines) on the remote then choose Move . The Fire TV remote works like an Android TV one: arrows move the selection, Select confirms, Back goes back. In live TV, up and down change channel. Not every remote has Channel +/− keys. See Install Kastideo on Android TV .

Typing a long password with a remote is tedious. The most comfortable way: set Kastideo up on a computer, export the backup file, then import it: see Interfaces and personalisation . The Fire TV phone app also offers a keyboard to type text.
All APKs are signed with the same key: install the new version over the old one, your settings are kept. What's new is on the What's new page.
